title: Session recovery request
description: What Kiln's extension inside Pi asks the supervisor for when the current session cannot go on, or when the operator asked for a new one (#178). ⚠️ THE EXTENSION ASKS; ONLY THE SUPERVISOR CHANGES WHICH SESSION IS RECORDED. The session record is written under the session lock by the process that owns it, so the agent leaves a request and exits, and the supervisor mints and records the new session before starting Pi on it. ⚠️ BOUND TO ONE RUN AND CONSUMED ONCE. A request names the run that wrote it; one left by an earlier run is discarded unread by any later one. ⚠️ A REASON FROM A FIXED LIST AND NOTHING ELSE. No path, no credential, no prompt, no tool result and no error text: the reason says which recovery, and the project's own state says the rest.

runId.description: The supervisor run this request belongs to. A request whose run is not the reader's is stale.

reason.description: `operator-new-session` is the operator's own request. The other three are failures Kiln recovers from automatically, at most once per launch.
